body: Product photography of a single tall street lamppost object, isolated on a plain solid black seamless backdrop with zero environment, zero scenery, zero ground texture beyond a small flat shadow directly under the base -- shot exactly like a studio catalog photo of ONE object, not an illustrated night scene. Camera angle: three-quarter view rotated 30 degrees off dead-front, so the lantern head, pole, and hexagonal base plate are all distinctly separated in silhouette (a flat front-on view is NOT acceptable). The object itself: a slender tapering dark obsidian-black brushed-metal pole roughly 4.5 meters tall, a heavy hexagonal cast-metal base plate, two thin acid-lime neon accent rings banding the pole, and an angular faceted glass lantern head at the top glowing a single consistent electric-cyan color (not pink, not magenta) as its own light source, casting a small cyan pool of light only on the tiny shadow patch beneath it. No character, no other props, no sky, no clouds, no stars, no horizon line, no puddle reflections.

Product photography of a single stylized tree object, isolated on a plain solid black seamless backdrop with zero environment -- NO sky, NO clouds, NO stars, NO horizon, NO ground plane beyond a small flat shadow at the base -- shot exactly like a studio catalog photo of ONE object, not an illustrated landscape scene. Camera angle: three-quarter view so the branch structure reads with real depth and overlap (not a flat symmetrical silhouette). The object itself, full height in frame roughly 5 meters tall: a dark obsidian-black angular low-poly trunk and branches, topped with a single rounded canopy mass of faceted gem-like leaf clusters in acid-lime with thin hot-magenta glowing veins running through the facets -- one canopy shape, not scattered separate leaf sprays. No character, no other props, no atmospheric background of any kind.
